Title: Preflight inventory and reconciliation
User story / technical objective: Before writing code, inventory what exists so IADM-06 reuses it and duplicates nothing.
Acceptance criteria: One-page report covering: branch and working-tree state; conventions of IADM-01, 02, 04 and 05 (port, gateway route prefix, permission-key naming, migration style, RLS and FORCE RLS style, demo-persona seeding pattern); the exact read contracts IADM-01 and IADM-04 offer for aggregates and the fields they return; how IADM-05's domain contract authenticates and registers a caller, which policy types and record categories it can resolve, and whether a published export or data-handling policy exists for an analytics domain; shared identity claims; shared audit capability and its failure behaviour; existing ADM or analytics code and tables with a reuse/adapt/move/split/replace/retire proposal (D10); service-name check against the architecture document (D11); the BFF path; which demo personas and demo records already exist. Anything not found is written as TBC. Confirms the DB target is the DEV Supabase project.
Build default or status: Read-only; no code or DB change

Title: IADM-06 service scaffold
User story / technical objective: Create IADM-06 as a separate deployable Java service following the conventions found in the preflight.
Acceptance criteria: Service starts; health endpoint answers; gateway route added with no collision against legacy /api/v1/admin/... routes; exception handling and structured logging; no sensitive payload in logs; technical doc started. Route and port reported.
Build default or status: Port and route follow the convention found in preflight, not memory

Title: Permission keys and role mapping
User story / technical objective: Define the IADM-06 permission keys and map them to roles.
Acceptance criteria: Capabilities: platform aggregate view; own-institute view; entitlement insight; aggregate export (request, status, result); read-only metric catalogue. Mapping: Super Admin (R01) platform view and export; System Admin (R02) platform view and export, no manage; Institution Admin (R03) own institute only, view and export; College Admin (R04) nothing; Auditor (R28) view only, never export. Manage-analytics-definitions key is reserved and NOT implemented. Names follow the convention from preflight. No wildcard key; no role outside R01, R02, R03, R28 receives any key; each denial tested.
Build default or status: Key strings are reported, not approved in advance

Title: Schema, tenant scoping and row-level security
User story / technical objective: Create only two stores in DEV: the versioned read-only metric catalogue and the export-request metadata.
Acceptance criteria: Migration applied only after the target is verified as DEV. No analytics fact table, no aggregate snapshot, no copies of other services' data, no dashboard-configuration table. Row-level security and FORCE row-level security on both tables. Test: Institution Admin of one institute cannot read another institute's export metadata; missing or mismatched tenant context fails closed. Rollback script included.
Build default or status: Physical names are a build proposal, reported at S0

Title: Shared audit integration
User story / technical objective: Emit audit events for every view of platform or comparison data, every export request and every export result through the existing shared audit capability.
Acceptance criteria: Reuses the capability found in preflight; no second audit store. Event carries actor, action, scope, policy version and outcome reference, no figures or payload. If required audit cannot be recorded, the action is refused. Test covers audit-unavailable.
Build default or status: If no reusable audit capability exists this is a blocker: report

Title: IADM-05 policy resolution client
User story / technical objective: IADM-06 acts as the first real consumer of the IADM-05 domain contract: resolve the applicable policy version before releasing a dataset or export, and report the outcome.
Acceptance criteria: Dataset or export is released only when exactly one published version resolves; none or more than one means withheld (fail closed) with a clear message. Outcome reported back through the contract using the correlation id. If no published policy exists for the analytics domain, create and publish DEMO ONLY versions through IADM-05's existing lifecycle (data, not code). No IADM-05 code changes: if the contract cannot express what is needed, record it as a finding and keep the affected stories partial.
Build default or status: Blueprint text says IADM-05 is the first consumer; the intended meaning is that IADM-06 is

Title: Source read clients for IADM-01 and IADM-04
User story / technical objective: Synchronous read access to institute, college, lifecycle, plan, subscription and entitlement facts through the owners' contracts.
Acceptance criteria: Never reads another service's tables directly. Timeouts and errors give 'source unavailable', never zero. If no suitable aggregate read contract exists, a minimal additive read-only endpoint may be added in the owning service as a separate commit, with no change to existing behaviour, and reported. Scope and tenant context passed from trusted context only.
Build default or status: Additive owner endpoints are allowed only if preflight proves the gap

Title: View platform aggregate overview
User story / technical objective: As R01 Super Admin, I can view a policy-permitted platform aggregate overview.
Acceptance criteria: Overview shows M01, M02, M03, M04, M07 and M08 from IADM-01 and IADM-04 seeded data, with the resolved policy version visible. Drill-down only into permitted aggregate dimensions; no raw or person-level rows anywhere. DEMO values label where applicable. Unresolved policy withholds the data. Audit event recorded.
Build default or status: None

Title: View the read-only metric catalogue
User story / technical objective: As R01 Super Admin or R02 System Admin, I can view the versioned metric catalogue.
Acceptance criteria: Screen lists M01 to M10 with definition, source owner, grain, windows, who may see it, small-group rule and catalogue version. No edit, create or delete control; any write attempt returns 403. Seeded, never empty.
Build default or status: Manage capability reserved and deferred

Title: View platform aggregates
User story / technical objective: As R02 System Admin, I can view platform aggregates.
Acceptance criteria: Same platform overview as R01 for viewing; no manage action exists; export control appears only per the export story. Access by a role without the key returns 403.
Build default or status: R02 is view and export only

Title: Access denied for IADM-06
User story / technical objective: As R04 College Admin, I receive an access-denied result for IADM-06.
Acceptance criteria: No menu entry; every IADM-06 endpoint returns 403 for R04; the screen route shows an access-denied page with no data. Same denial for one role from R05 to R27 or R29 to R39.
Build default or status: None

Title: Metric catalogue seed (M01 to M10)
User story / technical objective: Seed the read-only, versioned catalogue of the ten approved first metrics.
Acceptance criteria: Each entry holds identifier, plain definition, source owner (IADM-01 or IADM-04), grain, supported windows, visibility, small-group policy reference and catalogue version. M01 institutes by lifecycle status; M02 total institutes; M03 colleges per institute; M04 colleges by lifecycle status; M05 institutes created; M06 colleges created; M07 subscriptions by plan; M08 subscriptions by state; M09 entitlement consumption versus limit; M10 subscription state trend. No adoption or domain-activity metric is seeded. No write API exists.
Build default or status: Approval of blueprint V1.1 approves this list

Title: Aggregation engine and small-group suppression
User story / technical objective: Compute metrics on request and apply suppression and the reconstruction guard.
Acceptance criteria: Computed per request from source contracts; nothing persisted. Groups below the configurable threshold are withheld with a visible reason. Guard: totals or complementary groups cannot be used to derive a withheld value by subtraction (withhold the complementary group too). Values from IADM-04 records still marked DEMO carry the label 'DEMO values' in metric, chart and export. Suppression applies to platform-scope groupings and cross-institute comparisons; own-institute views contain only the actor's own institute facts and are not suppressed.
Build default or status: BUILD DEFAULT: own-institute views not suppressed (owner may overrule). Threshold is a runtime setting; blueprint demo default is 5, DEMO ONLY, not a privacy standard; production value OWNER-OPEN

Title: Demo dataset and personas
User story / technical objective: Make every screen show real figures from the existing demo records.
Acceptance criteria: Reuse IADM-01 demo institutes and colleges and IADM-04 plan, subscription and entitlement demo records; do not duplicate them. Personas: Super Admin (R01), System Admin (R02), Institution Admin (R03) for each demo institute, College Admin (R04), Auditor (R28); use accounts the owner already created and follow the existing demo-persona pattern; invent no emails. One deliberate no-data institute and time window. A clearly labelled DEMO ONLY adoption fixture exists only to show deferred metrics. Because the seeded data is small, the demo suppression threshold is set as a DEMO ONLY runtime value so figures show, and the headed run also raises it to show suppression working. Seeds idempotent and removable. No real personal data.
Build default or status: Report the demo threshold value used

Title: Compare institutes
User story / technical objective: As R01 Super Admin, I can compare institutes using approved aggregate dimensions.
Acceptance criteria: Institute selector and time window; comparison of M03, M06, M08 and M09 across institutes. Groups below the threshold are withheld with a reason; subtraction guard proven by test (no value derivable from totals). No raw rows. DEMO values label shown.
Build default or status: None

Title: View own-institute analytics
User story / technical objective: As R03 Institution Admin, I can view aggregate analytics for my institute only.
Acceptance criteria: My Institute Overview shows M01 to M10 scoped to the institute's own facts. No cross-institute comparison control. Requesting another institute's data (changed id in the request) is refused. Headed check with R03 of a second institute shows no data of the first.
Build default or status: For an own-institute view, metrics that count institutes (M01, M02, M05) show the institute's own single row, not a platform total

Title: Inspect entitlement consumption across institutes
User story / technical objective: As R01 Super Admin, I can inspect entitlement-usage aggregates from IADM-04.
Acceptance criteria: Platform view of M09 (consumption versus limit) and M07, M08, from IADM-04 only; IADM-06 does not redefine entitlements. IADM-04 unavailable shows 'unavailable', never an inferred value. DEMO values label when IADM-04 records are still DEMO.
Build default or status: None

Actor / role: Super Admin (R01); Institution Admin (R03) for own institute
Title: View trend series
User story / technical objective: As R01 Super Admin, I can view approved platform trend series; R03 sees the same for own institute.
Acceptance criteria: Trend Explorer shows M05, M06 and M10 by day, month or quarter only where source timestamps or history support it; otherwise it says the source does not support that window, never a made-up series. Suppression applies at platform scope.
Build default or status: Historical support depends on what IADM-01 and IADM-04 store (reported at preflight)

Title: View entitlement insight within scope
User story / technical objective: As R01 Super Admin or R03 Institution Admin, I can view an entitlement-usage insight within my authorized scope.
Acceptance criteria: R01 selects an institute; R03 sees own institute only. Shows M07 to M09 for that scope. Out-of-scope request refused.
Build default or status: None

Title: Export platform aggregates
User story / technical objective: As R01 Super Admin or R02 System Admin, I can export permitted platform aggregates within my authorized scope.
Acceptance criteria: Aggregate Export Review shows the figures, scope, suppression applied and policy resolution; I request CSV, see status, and download the streamed file. Audit event recorded. Unresolved policy refuses the export with a clear message. Auditor (R28) cannot export (403).
Build default or status: None

Title: Export own-institute aggregates
User story / technical objective: As R03 Institution Admin, I can export permitted aggregates for my institute only.
Acceptance criteria: Export Aggregate Summary produces CSV of own-institute figures only; any other institute's scope refused; status and audit as above.
Build default or status: None

Title: See no-data, unavailable and partial states
User story / technical objective: As R01 Super Admin or R03 Institution Admin, I see no-data, source-unavailable and partial states correctly, never a fake zero.
Acceptance criteria: No-data institute and window shows 'No analytics available for this scope'. Stopping IADM-01 or IADM-04 in DEV shows 'temporarily unavailable' for the affected metrics only. Partial or stale labels appear only when the source timestamp or status is known. Recovery: refresh shows real figures again.
Build default or status: None

Actor / role: Super Admin (R01); System Admin (R02); Institution Admin (R03)
Title: View export status and result
User story / technical objective: As R01, R02 or R03, I can view export status and result within my authorized scope.
Acceptance criteria: List shows own authorized requests with status, scope and time. A failed export can be retried safely; a completed export is not duplicated. Another institute's exports are not visible to R03. No file payload is stored.
Build default or status: None

Title: Aggregate export engine
User story / technical objective: Aggregate-only CSV export with request metadata and no stored file.
Acceptance criteria: Lifecycle REQUESTED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED or FAILED. CSV contains only the figures shown, within the actor's scope, with suppression and DEMO labels applied; never raw or person-level rows. Generated on request and streamed; only metadata (requester, scope, filter snapshot, resolved policy version and outcome, status, timestamps, audit correlation) is stored. A single published IADM-05 policy version must resolve or the export is refused. Retry regenerates from the stored filter snapshot and never duplicates a completed export.
Build default or status: Own-scope and platform-wide aggregate exports have no approval step (platform-wide approval is OWNER-OPEN, recommended no)

Title: Read-only analytics
User story / technical objective: As R28 Auditor, I can inspect authorized aggregate analytics read-only.
Acceptance criteria: Views permitted aggregate screens in the assigned scope; every export, create, update or manage attempt returns 403; no export control shown.
Build default or status: BUILD DEFAULT: if no audit-scope assignment exists in RBAC, R28 sees platform aggregates read-only; reported at preflight

Title: Enforce policy, isolation, audit and safe failure
User story / technical objective: As R01 Super Admin, I can rely on the platform enforcing policy, tenant isolation, audit and safe failure and resume.
Acceptance criteria: Headed run shows: unresolved IADM-05 policy withholds the dataset; wrong or missing tenant context is refused; a source stopped in DEV shows unavailable then recovers; audit unavailable refuses the action then recovers; failed export retries without duplicates. Faults are simulated by stopping the DEV service or a DEMO ONLY switch, with no new tooling.
Build default or status: None

Title: Failure, isolation and role test suite
User story / technical objective: Automated tests for every row of the blueprint failure table and for role and tenant boundaries.
Acceptance criteria: Covers no permitted data, permission denied, invalid institute context, source unavailable, policy unavailable or unresolved, partial or stale source, export failure and retry, audit unavailable. Role tests for R01, R02, R03 (two institutes), R04, R28 and one role from R05 to R27 or R29 to R39 that must be denied. Log-leak check: no figures, tokens or credentials in logs.
Build default or status: None

Title: Evidence pack and close-out
User story / technical objective: Prove the work is done the way the owner defined done.
Acceptance criteria: Headed run for each persona (R01, R02, R03 for two institutes, R04 denied, R28) showing real seeded figures on every screen; test results; plain-language report; blueprint demo checklist ticked with evidence; the two open compliance items (permission keys with audit event names; route collision check) closed with the exact verified values; decisions D1 to D11 with what the build assumed; list of partial rows if any.
Build default or status: None
